name: South Africa
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Flame ionization detector
inventions.description: A flame ionization detector (FID) is a scientific instrument that measures analytes in a gas stream.

inventions.name: Black & Decker Workmate
inventions.description: The Black & Decker Workmate is a general purpose portable workbench and general carpentry tool manufactured under the brand Black & Decker.

inventions.name: South African Class 6E1, Series 4
inventions.description: The South African Railways Class 6E1, Series 4 of 1973 was an electric locomotive.

inventions.name: Casspir
inventions.description: The Casspir is a Mine-Resistant Ambush Protected Vehicle that has been in use in South Africa since the 1980s.

inventions.name: Denel Rooivalk
inventions.description: The Denel Rooivalk is an attack helicopter manufactured by Denel Aviation of South Africa.

inventions.name: Safety syringe
inventions.description: A safety syringe is a syringe with a built-in safety mechanism to reduce the risk of needlestick injuries to healthcare workers and others.

inventions.name: Amoriguard
inventions.description: Amoriguard is a water-based paint with fillers based on recycled industrial waste.
